thesis: COLM is a stretched, low-growth apparel name being bought into a confirmed risk-off tape (QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX percentile 0.981, 5 of 15 sectors above their 50-day). After a +24% 21-day run the stock trades above the mean analyst target, with RSI above 70 and a director selling into strength. The rally rests on margin recovery, not sales: revenue growth is about 2%, and no news item confirms the driver. With 19% of float short and no fresh catalyst, a momentum unwind or a broad-market air pocket can quickly take the price back toward the 70.0 stop and the breakout base.
